data.explanation: This letter from the Familienkasse ends child benefit (Kindergeld) payments for your son Jonas from September 2027, because he finished his vocational training and started full-time work on 1 August 2027. You already received the August 2027 payment and do not need to repay anything. If you disagree with this decision, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Familienkasse Beispiel-Nord; the app shows the deadline for this. If you let the deadline pass, the decision becomes final and no payments will resume on this basis.

data.summary: The Familienkasse Beispiel-Nord cancels the child benefit (Kindergeld) determination for the son Jonas with effect from September 2027, because he completed his vocational training on 31 July 2027 and started full-time employment on 1 August 2027. The benefit for August 2027 remains due and was already paid, so no repayment is required.
data.tax_note: Child benefit (Kindergeld) is checked by the tax office against the child tax allowance (Günstigerprüfung) in the annual income tax assessment, so the end date of entitlement can affect the tax return.
